description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of difficulty levels across a dataset, likely representing the complexity of questions or tasks. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different difficulty level: “easy” (teal), “medium” (blue), “CoT” (yellow), “N+K” (orange), “N-K” (red), and “N-K+” (green). The “easy” slice occupies approximately 40.6% of the chart, while “medium” accounts for 44.6%. The “CoT” slice represents 36.2%, followed by “N+K” at 36.8%, “N-K” at 7.0%, and “N-K+” at 20.1%. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from larger to smaller proportions, though this is not strictly consistent. A legend is not present, but each slice is clearly labeled with its corresponding difficulty level.
